_doc: EV-4 canary Campaign (tests/ev4/fixtures.py). Party-visible fields hold plain text; every GM-only field or record holds a {canary:KIND} placeholder, replaced by a unique CANARY-<KIND>-<uuid4> token each time the seed is loaded. KIND is [A-Z0-9]+. A token in a response to anyone but a GM of the token's Campaign is a leak. Add a placeholder here whenever a GM-only field or table lands.
